Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

submit verb

hand in, put forward

also hand in, submit an application, submit a report, submission, put forward (for approval), turn in, hand it in, hand in the papers, hand in your work, classroom commands, pass the papers to the front

classical

Cic. Fam. 5.20.3: ratiōnēs dēferre, to hand in one’s accounts (Lewis & Short)

dēferō, dēferre, dētulī, dēlātum

verb, irregular, transitive; ad + acc. of the authority, conjugation

bring before, hand in (to an authority)

To bring something down to the place where it is dealt with: accounts or names to the treasury (ad aerārium), a matter to the senate or to a judge. So it fits a formal submission. It also means to report or denounce (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • trādō, trādere, trādidī, trāditum — hand over, hand in

    verb, third conjugation, transitive; the person in the dative · also used · classical · Traupman 29; Traupman 25: Trāde mihi., hand it in; Traupman 325

    The everyday word for handing in homework or a form (see give).

Examples

  • Pēnsum crās magistrō trāde.

    Hand your homework in to the teacher tomorrow.composed

  • Chartās redde (reddite).

    Hand in the papers.Traupman 33

  • Chartās trāde (trādite).

    Hand in the papers.Traupman 33

  • Chartās trāde (trādite) ad frontem.

    Pass the papers to the front.Traupman 34

See also give, offer, propose, homework.
